grades.A: Derived from an authoritative published dataset, an official dimension, or an archival drawing.
grades.B: Derived from consistent imagery or community mapping combined with known control geometry.
grades.C: Derived from a reconstructed attribute, an aligned mesh, or photogrammetry.
grades.D: Inferred, decorative, or placeholder. Never citable as a dimension.

tier_rule: No Tier C source may override Tier A geometry.

sources.title: NYC Building Footprints
sources.publisher: NYC Office of Technology and Innovation, via NYC Open Data
sources.license: NYC Open Data Terms of Use
sources.notes: Plan geometry and roof heights. Positional accuracy is the publisher's stated +/- 2 ft for photogrammetrically captured features (ASPRS Class 1). height_roof is a height above ground_elevation, not an elevation.

sources.title: NYC MapPLUTO / PLUTO tax lot attributes
sources.publisher: NYC Department of City Planning, via NYC Open Data
sources.license: NYC Open Data Terms of Use
sources.attribution_text: Lot attributes: NYC Department of City Planning (PLUTO)
sources.notes: Attributes only: address, owner, class, land use, floors, year built. Never a geometry source. Floor counts fall back to grade C via DCTL-062.

sources.title: NYC building footprint published metadata
sources.license: NYC Open Data Terms of Use
sources.notes: Authoritative attribute definitions. The source of the statement that HEIGHTROOF is measured above GROUNDELEV and that GROUNDELEV is NAVD88.

sources.title: NYC Neighborhood Tabulation Areas 2020
sources.publisher: NYC Department of City Planning, via NYC Open Data
sources.license: NYC Open Data Terms of Use
sources.notes: Context only. BK0202 is 'Downtown Brooklyn-DUMBO-Boerum Hill' and is much larger than this project's subject, so it is NOT used as the boundary.

sources.title: NOAA CO-OPS tidal datums, station 8518750 (The Battery, NY)
sources.notes: Epoch 1983-2001, relative to station datum: MHW 2.44, NAVD88 1.85. Yields DCTL-010, MHW = NAVD88 + 0.59 m.

sources.title: NYSAPLS tide datum reference for station 8518750
sources.publisher: New York State Association of Professional Land Surveyors
sources.notes: Independent corroboration: MHW 0.596 m above NAVD88. Agrees with DSRC-005.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap street, footway and landmark data
sources.notes: Walk network and landmark names and positions. ODbL requires attribution wherever this is rendered; the viewer displays it unconditionally.

sources.publisher: NYC Office of Technology and Innovation
sources.license: NYC Open Data Terms of Use

sources.title: NYC Forestry Management System street trees
sources.publisher: NYC Parks, via NYC Open Data
sources.license: NYC Open Data Terms of Use
sources.attribution_text: Street trees: NYC Parks Forestry Management System
sources.notes: Position, species and trunk diameter (dbh, inches) per street tree. Positions and species are grade A; the rendered canopy is a procedural form for the genus and is therefore graded C.

sources.title: NYC Building Footprints, Lower Manhattan frontage
sources.publisher: NYC Office of Technology and Innovation, via NYC Open Data
sources.license: NYC Open Data Terms of Use
sources.notes: Same dataset as DSRC-001, queried across the river for the skyline visible from DUMBO. Delivered as silhouette blocks, so the rendered geometry is graded B even though the source is A. See DOQ-008.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap ferry routes and terminals
sources.notes: East River ferry route lines and landings, including the real Pier 11 to DUMBO/Fulton Ferry service. Vessels follow these lines; their speed and spacing are nominal, not a timetable. See DOQ-009.
